entities.name: Galina III
entities.description: Empress of the Vodalian merfolk empire in the Voda Sea; founded New Vodalia and reigned until killed by Yawgmoth's death cloud.

entities.name: Vodalian merfolk empire
entities.description: Merfolk empire in the Voda Sea near Sarpadia.

entities.name: Karel Volnikov
entities.description: Marshall who led the Vodalian army against the homarids.

entities.name: Homarids
entities.description: Invaders who overwhelmed Vodalia by breeding and flourishing.

entities.name: Akoroun
entities.description: Mage who created the magic portal.

entities.name: Etlan Shiis
entities.description: Distant colony the Vodalians were to be transported to.

entities.name: New Vodalia
entities.description: Empire reformed by Galina after defeating the local merfolk kingdom.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian whose death cloud killed Galina.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion during which Galina still reigned.

events.summary: Homarids invade; Karel Volnikov leads the Vodalian army, which is later overwhelmed.
events.quote: Marshall Karel Volnikov led the Vodalian army against them

events.summary: Vodalia is abandoned and many subjects follow Galina through Akoroun's magic portal, arriving three thousand years in the future.
events.quote: arrive three thousand years in the future

events.summary: Galina's army defeats the local merfolk kingdom and reforms the empire as New Vodalia.
events.quote: Galina's army defeated the local merfolk kingdom, and reformed the empire as New Vodalia

events.summary: Galina is killed by Yawgmoth's death cloud, ending her thousand-year reign.
